annotations.title: Find where a property can be booked

description: Look up one named property and every way it can be booked, including the host's or manager's own site. Takes propertyName plus city (most reliable), or a listing URL from a booking platform, which is matched on its listing id. The response has answerType "lookup": a lookup about one property, not a ranked search. `confidence` describes the match: `exact-ota-id`, CielStay holds that exact listing; `exact-title`, the name matched but it is not confirmed to be the same property; `discovered-match`, CielStay does not hold it, but after reading the pasted link (title and location only) it found a booking-site page that agrees on name and place, which is likely but not certain; `none`, CielStay has no record, which does not show that no direct option exists. Every booking URL in the response is one CielStay holds or found; none is constructed. For a pasted link CielStay does not hold, the lookup reads that one page and searches live (up to about 20 seconds); `otaListing` shows what was read. When the answer is none, `alternatives` lists different, direct-bookable homes near `place` (matchType "alternative"), and `possibleMatches` lists the closest unconfirmed candidates by name and meaning (matchType "possible", no booking link, `matchScore` 0-1 is closeness, not proof). Readable version: https://www.cielstay.com/lookup?q=<name or link>.

city.description: The city, to disambiguate a property name. Names repeat across towns.

otaUrl.description: The Airbnb or Vrbo URL the traveller is looking at. Paste it exactly as they gave it — tracking parameters and locale prefixes are fine. This is the most reliable input.

place.description: The town or area the traveller says the property is in. Only used to list direct-bookable alternatives near it when we do not hold the property; it never changes whether it matched.

propertyName.description: The property name, if you have no URL. Exact spelling as shown on the OTA listing.
